item.title: The Best Moments From KCON LA 2026 (So Far)
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Upbeat K-pop music plays]
Host: "Hey, K-pop fans! Welcome to our special episode, coming to you live from KCON LA 2026! The city of Los Angeles is buzzing with all things K-pop, and we're here to give you the scoop on the biggest K-pop event of the year."
[Short music transition]
Host: "KCON officially kicked off on Friday at the Los Angeles Convention Center and Crypto.com Arena, with a theme of 'Walk in SOUL CITY'. But the city has been immersed in K-pop culture all week. HYBE America got things started on Wednesday with an industry party, featuring performers like &TEAM, Santos Bravos, and SAINT SATINE."
[Short sound clip of K-pop music]
Host: "Meanwhile, retail stores like hello82 and KPop Nara have been hosting daily signings and fan events with artists like Wonho and ZEROBASEONE, giving fans a chance to meet their idols up close. And if that's not enough, the KCON festival grounds feature multiple stages, including the Artist Stage, Dance Stage, and Toyota Music Den Stage, with a packed lineup of performers."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This year, the daily headliners are performing full hour-long sets, a first in KCON history. And with past performers like BTS, TWICE, and SEVENTEEN going on to sell out stadiums and arenas, KCON has proven to be an important launching pad for K-pop acts in the US. We'll be bringing you all the highlights from the festival, so stay tuned for more updates throughout the weekend!"
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the flip side! Don't forget to follow us for more K-pop news and updates."
